title: Numerical study of loss of hyperbolicity using a cold plasma model
summary: We study a one-dimensional system of cold plasma equations taking into account electron-ion collisions in both relativistic and nonrelativistic cases. It is known that for a constant collision coefficient $ν$, the solution to the Cauchy problem for such a system can lose smoothness. However, if the dependence of $ν$ on the electron density $N$ is more than linear, then the solution remains globally smooth for any initial data.
